properties.name: spring.webflux.cors.enabled
properties.description: Global switch to enable or disable CORS handling in the API Gateway.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret key used to validate JWT tokens at the gateway. Must match the secret configured in all downstream services.

properties.name: management.zipkin.tracing.export.enabled
properties.description: Whether to export traces to the configured Zipkin endpoint.
